expectations.text: States the governing instrument: ANPD Resolution 19/2024 (the international transfer regulation)
Lists the mechanisms: adequacy decisions (none issued to date), ANPD standard contractual clauses, binding corporate rules, specific guarantees
expectations.evidence: "the ANPD has not recognised the US as adequate... Do not rely on adequacy"; lists SCCs, "specific contractual clauses", "Binding corporate rules (BCRs)", "Seals, certificates and codes of conduct"

expectations.text: States the SCC deadline reality: the 12-month grace period ended August 23, 2025 — ANPD SCCs must now be incorporated in transfer contracts (old DPA language doesn't suffice)
expectations.evidence: "The deadline to migrate existing contracts to the ANPD SCCs was 23 August 2025"; pitfall: "Failing to update existing intra-group agreements by the deadline"

expectations.text: Notes transparency/documentation duties around transfers (RoPA, notice to data subjects)
expectations.evidence: "privacy notice should disclose the international transfer, the countries, the mechanism"; "Keep records: ROPA with the transfer entries, signed SCCs"

expectations.text: Practical advice: audit existing intercompany agreements for ANPD SCC incorporation; don't rely on consent as a transfer workhorse
expectations.evidence: "Map the flows... Execute the SCCs verbatim"; "Consent is fragile because it can be revoked"; "Relying on consent for HR data" listed as pitfall
